title: Adapting a Frozen Anticipatory Music Transformer for Turn-Based MIDI Call-and-Response
description: Code and audit outputs for adapting a frozen Anticipatory Music Transformer to turn-based MIDI call-and-response. Version 1.2.0 adds Call/source-cluster inference, matched-versus-mismatched symbolic feature association, corrected first-commit endpoint semantics, commit-anchored scheduler replay, an A4 fallback guard, path-redacted provenance, regression tests, and the revised manuscript. No human-participant evidence is included.
notes: This archive excludes model weights, license-sensitive source datasets, generated MIDI response batches, all human-participant response data and aggregate outcomes, private answer keys, deployment credentials, piano sample libraries, VST plugins, and DAWs. Published trial tables contain path-redacted filenames and SHA-256 values; recomputing the feature-association analysis from MIDI requires locally regenerated response files.
